crossRefs.note: In my Father’s house are many homes. If it weren’t so, I would have told you. I am going to prepare a place for you.
You heard how I told you, ‘I go away, and I come to you.’ If you loved me, you would have rejoiced, because I said ‘I…
Jesus, knowing that the Father had given all things into his hands, and that he came from God, and was going to God,
I came from the Father, and have come into the world. Again, I leave the world, and go to the Father.”
Didn’t the Christ have to suffer these things and to enter into his glory?”
For God so loved the world, that he gave his one and only Son, that whoever believes in him should not perish, but have…
For God didn’t send his Son into the world to judge the world, but that the world should be saved through him.
One who believes in the Son has eternal life, but one who disobeys the Son won’t see life, but the wrath of God remains…
This is the will of the one who sent me, that everyone who sees the Son, and believes in him, should have eternal life…
Simon Peter answered him, “Lord, to whom would we go? You have the words of eternal life.
We have come to believe and know that you are the Christ, the Son of the living God.”
I am the door. If anyone enters in by me, he will be saved, and will go in and go out, and will find pasture.
If anyone serves me, let him follow me. Where I am, there my servant will also be. If anyone serves me, the Father will…

translations.web: You know where I go, and you know the way.”
translations.bsb: You know the way to the place where I am going.”
translations.kjv: And whither I go ye know, and the way ye know.
translations.asv: And whither I go, ye know the way.
